# Monsmith

> Monsmith (https://www.monsmith.com) is the free, browser-based, AI-powered smart contract IDE for Monad. Write, compile, audit, profile for parallel execution, deploy, and migrate Solidity contracts with zero setup. Founded and built by Adwait Keshari.

Full site as one document: https://www.monsmith.com/llms-full.txt

## Founder

- Adwait Keshari: founder of Monsmith. Full-stack and blockchain engineer, BS Data Science student at IIT Madras, based in Bhopal, India. Three-time hackathon builder; organises ETH Builders Day Bhopal, leads Bhopal DAO and AarambhLabs, runs workshops for Sahyog Club at IIT Madras, speaks at Monad community events.

## Key facts

- Monad: EVM-compatible Layer 1, optimistic parallel execution, MonadBFT consensus, 300 ms blocks, 600 ms finality, 10,000 TPS target. Mainnet chain ID 143, testnet chain ID 10143. Native token MON.
- Monsmith features: Monaco Solidity editor, in-browser Hardhat compilation with OpenZeppelin, AI-assisted security audit, Monad parallel execution profiler with dependency graphs, Chain Fit gas comparison, one-click deployment to Monad testnet, guided migration, tutorials, guides, glossary.
- No wallet is needed to write, compile, audit, or profile; a wallet is only needed to deploy.
- Free, open source, no account required.
